text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Satono 
Diamond and I passed by a convenience 
store... where two Umamusume were hanging 
out.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! Flamin-ko AGAIN?! This is my fifth 
one already...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This one is... a caterpillar too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My, Golshi and Nakayama? Whatever could 
they be doing in a place like this? —I 
shall go ask them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chased after Satono Diamond, all while 
having a bad feeling about this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Good day. What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Satono! Truth is, I just bought a 
whole bunch of 'Prank Critter Chocolates'!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, the ultra-rare Ammonite Knight just 
won't show up... so I've been scarfing 
these down one after another.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so this is a new challenge? Sounds 
fascinating! May I please join in as well?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what a curious little lady. ...Fine 
by me, which one do you want? Take your 
pick.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Which bag do you think is best, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that one was better too! Let's 
open it up, then. Here goes—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Here goes――!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is, um, from a Ptera...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—The Ptera Don!!!! Whoaa, it's the Don of 
Pteras, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the Gold Class, huh? ...Not too 
shabby, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it was something good, wasn't it?! 
In that case, I'd love to open even more!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, go for it! Just send 'em flowing 
down my way, and I'll eat every single 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Here goes—
Hold on a second, death!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“I was actually planning on buying some 
'Surprise Creature Chocolates' too, YES!!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
They were all sold out, though... So it 
was your fault, Golshi-san and 
Nakayama-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's gotten into you, El? Being all 
touchy... Can't be helped, then. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"—This means a showdown! If you win, 
you'll be the Boss of the Pteras! Lose, 
and you'll be a buzzing cicada!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Challenge accepted! I will 
definitely win and become the Don of the 
Pteras!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then, fair and square—!!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & El
text_block_list.text: —Let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, things have turned into quite a 
mess, haven't they, Trainer?

“—Don't worry. If you just leave them 
alone, they'll run out of steam 
eventually...”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Cafe-san! Are you out shopping as well?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my usual café was closed, so... I 
ended up here...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"However—I think I will go to a different 
café after all... Excuse me..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"My, you have that many regular cafes? If 
you don't mind, could I come along too!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond prioritized her curiosity, 
paying no mind to the battle unfolding 
right before her eyes. ...Once again, I 
felt like I caught a glimpse of her 
innocence.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you're daring to take on the challenge! 
Sounds fun. Here I come, then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, just as Satono Diamond went to 
open the bag—a sudden gust of wind blew 
the bag of chocolates right over to 
someone's feet.
Nn... What's this?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, snack wrappers? What is this, 
kindergarten playtime?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Good timing. Care to join in, 
Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Compete, as in with sweets? Come on, at 
this point, over something that stupid—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. A pure, innocent young lady, are 
ya? Going up against you might actually be 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ? By 'do it', do you mean a match?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If what just rolled to your feet is 
a winner, then you win.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However, if you're wrong, you lose. You'll 
have to do one thing I say. —How's that 
sound?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how interesting. Under those 
conditions, there's no way I can let 
myself lose♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I gladly accept the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Here goes—!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: A secret character!! Ste5saurus...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The instant the card was revealed, Gold 
Ship and Nakayama Festa jumped on it with 
terrifying fervor...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
!? A hidden character...? Does that mean 
it's neither a win nor a lose?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, whatever. The bet's off. Well, 
instead of beating you, I got to see 
something interesting at least.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Then shall we carry this match over 
to another time, if that's alright with 
you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The matter wasn't settled. Please, allow 
me one more match!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, hahaha! After you went through 
all the trouble of making it out unharmed, 
you're gonna throw it away yourself!?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I'll be waiting at the top. 
Until the moment you finally climb up to 
meet me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ That gives us one more goal to aim 
for, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Diamond confronting her seniors 
without fear. Once again, I felt like I 
caught a glimpse of her inner strength."
